spoken_summary: Donald Trump discusses his foreign policy achievements, expressing hope for a large peace agreement across the Middle East. He claims credit for silencing Hamas and for being the toughest president ever on Iran. He then describes a "memorandum of understanding," warning that if the other parties fail to honor it, the US will "probably go back to bombing them until they honor it." He concludes, "It's amazing what bombs can do."
